description: Spoiled Rotten Photography is a boutique preschool and school photography franchise founded in Huntsville, Alabama in 2003 and franchising since 2012. Franchisees operate a protected territory of 400,000+ population, photographing school and preschool students plus families, sports teams and events, using the company's system of specialized training, unique photo sets, online ordering and customer relationship software. The 2025 FDD reports 29 open outlets (25 franchised, 4 company-owned) across 12 states, with 2024 average gross sales of $279,597 across 19 full-time locations. Initial investment ranges from $52,695 to $64,350 with a $39,000 franchise fee and 9% royalty.
territoryDescription: Franchisee receives a Protected Territory of one or more contiguous zip codes with a population of at least 400,000 people, and may serve schools with addresses inside those zip codes (Item 12, FDD pp.24-26). The territory is not exclusive: the franchisor may face franchisees with competition from other franchisees, company-owned outlets, and alternative channels. Minimum Performance Standards require $50,000 in Year 1 gross sales, scaling to $275,000 in Year 10; failing for 2 consecutive years can trigger termination or territory reduction. Eight categories of rights are reserved to the franchisor, including operating outside the protected territory and Internet marketing. FDD Item 20 Table 1 (p82) lists 29 outlets as of 2024-12-31; all 29 are mapped as pins on this page.
